flags.why: This verb specifically describes a peafowl's cry, not bird calls generally ([dictionary](https://v2.rung.vn/dict/vn_vn/T%E1%BB%91_h%E1%BB%99)).
flags.fix: to cry; to call (of a peafowl)

flags.why: Using tố hộ for a rooster teaches an incorrect usage.
flags.fix: Con công tố hộ ngoài vườn. = The peafowl cries in the garden.

flags.why: Learners are most likely to encounter the beautiful-woman sense, notably in Truyện Kiều ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/t%E1%BB%91_nga)).
The example defines tố nga instead of using it to refer to the goddess.
flags.fix: Tố Nga ngự trên cung trăng. = Chang'e dwells in the moon palace.
